The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case when indicating location.
The preposition на (on, in) with the prepositional case indicates location or position.
The preposition за (for) with the accusative case expresses the reason or cause for praise.
The preposition за (for) governs the accusative case to express the reason for praise.
The instrumental case with implied preposition 'with' expresses the means or manner of praise.
The preposition на (on) with the prepositional case indicates the instrument used for praise.
The verb славит (praises) is transitive and requires the accusative case for its direct object.

reading.question: What is the significance of the word 'Аллилуйя' at the beginning and end of Psalm 150?
options: It is a Hebrew word meaning 'Praise Yah' or 'Praise the Lord'
It is a Greek word meaning 'blessed be'
It is a Slavic word meaning 'glory'
It is an instruction to be silent
reading.correct: It is a Hebrew word meaning 'Praise Yah' or 'Praise the Lord'
reading.explain: Аллилуйя (Alleluia) is a transliteration of the Hebrew 'Hallelu-Yah' (Praise Yah/the Lord).

reading.ru: Славьте Бога в его святилище, славьте его на небесах, твердыни его.
reading.question: Where should God be praised according to this verse?
options: In his sanctuary and in the heavens, his fortress
Only in the temple in Jerusalem
In private places away from others
Only at night and in secret
reading.correct: In his sanctuary and in the heavens, his fortress
reading.explain: The text explicitly mentions praising God in his sanctuary and in the heavens (твердыни его means his fortress/firmament).

reading.ru: Славьте его за могущественные дела его, славьте его за безмерное величие его.
reading.question: What are two reasons given for praising God in this verse?
options: His mighty deeds and his boundless greatness
His wisdom and his power over enemies
reading.correct: His mighty deeds and his boundless greatness
reading.explain: The text states 'Славьте его за могущественные дела его' (praise him for his mighty deeds) and 'славьте его за безмерное величие его' (praise him for his boundless greatness).

reading.ru: Славьте его звучанием рогов, славьте его на арфах и лирах, славьте его с бубнами и танцами.
reading.question: What instruments and activities are mentioned for praising God?
options: Trumpets, harps, lyres, tambourines, and dancing
reading.correct: Trumpets, harps, lyres, tambourines, and dancing
reading.explain: The text mentions: звучанием рогов (sounding of trumpets), арфах и лирах (harps and lyres), бубнами и танцами (tambourines and dancing).

reading.ru: Славьте его на струнных инструментах и свирелях.
reading.question: What additional instruments are mentioned for praising God?
reading.explain: The verse explicitly states 'на струнных инструментах и свирелях' (on stringed instruments and flutes).

reading.question: Who is called to praise the Lord in this final statement?
options: All living things that have breath
Only the righteous and holy people
reading.correct: All living things that have breath
reading.explain: The text says 'Все дышащее' (Everything that has breath/all living creatures) should praise the Lord.
